executionBlockersClosed.defect: The freeze script still generated the superseded ID-map access boundary while the committed map carried the Amendment 6 correction. Job A is preregistered to rerun the script and require bit-for-bit reproduction, so it had to either fail or overwrite the corrected map.
executionBlockersClosed.fix: the generator emits exactly the contract's boundary with the obsolete keys REMOVED rather than aliased; the committed map is aligned to the generator's exact output; a --check mode reproduces all three artifacts byte-for-byte from one shared implementation

executionBlockersClosed.defect: The actor table said Job A had no governed truth, while the freeze script reads the PR #217 attribution artifact and uses governedTruth.present for the 105/10 split. Acceptable Brand values live in the same case objects.
executionBlockersClosed.fix: the claim is replaced with the accurate physical-access statement and a bounded use rule; the first physical access to a truth-bearing source is recorded as occurring in trusted Job A; the actor-2/actor-3 boundary is restated as an EVALUATION-USE boundary
executionBlockersClosed.noninterferenceClaimIsBounded: Independence from governedTruth.present is NOT claimed. Independence from acceptable values and other truth TEXT is claimed and tested.

executionBlockersClosed.defect: The adapter took every diagnostic carrying a ranking and sorted by rankingScore descending, giving fake positions to deduplicated candidates and an order production never produced.
executionBlockersClosed.fix: final ranked membership is the set of candidates carrying a decision; members are ordered by production's exported compareCandidateRanking through a minimal { ranking } wrapper with the original array order as the stable tie-break; positions are contiguous and unique; the selected candidate is position 0

evidenceDefinitionCorrections: candidate supportPassIds and candidateProvenance are the PUBLIC pre-deduplication-merge values; the post-merge support is available only for the selected observation and is persisted separately; complete merged support for every ranked candidate is unavailable and is NOT reconstructed in the adapter
